core_obligations: Make the morphism DM so that it can be presented etale-locally (proof lines 8205-8206)

Build compatible etale presentations: choose a smooth cover of the base, an etale cover of the target over that cover and an etale cover of the source over the first cover, and observe that the composite map to the base cover is surjective etale (proof lines 8207-8220)

Reduce to the scheme-free statement: etaleness of the morphism of stacks follows from etaleness of the induced morphism of algebraic spaces, which is the version of the statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 8221-8228)
proof_roadmap: 先由「分离/DM 目标上的态射是 DM」得 X → Y 是 DM，从而有 etale 展示。
取 W → Z 满光滑；再取 V → Y ×_Z W 与 U → X ×_Y V 的 etale 展示，则 U → X ×_Z W 满 etale，只需 U → W etale。
U → W 与 V → W 都 etale（因 X、Y 在 Z 上 etale），由代数空间版的 etale 保持引理得 U → W etale。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for two algebraic stacks etale over a common base, every morphism between them over that base is etale (author lemma at source lines 8197-8202, label lemma-etale-permanence). The proof (source lines 8204-8229) makes the morphism DM, chooses compatible etale presentations over a smooth cover of the base, reduces to the induced morphism of algebraic spaces, and concludes by the version of the statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 8205-8228). The construction of the compatible presentations and the reduction to algebraic spaces are the content. H3.
